scenes.name: How it works
scenes.text: The title and what this film covers.

scenes.name: Two names
scenes.text: Pravrudhi-Nyaya is the product; Prabhasa-Nyaya is our own trained models; the system is a second reader that refers when it cannot support a statement.

scenes.name: The corpus
scenes.text: Real judgments and orders are gathered, cleaned, read by two model readers, checked and split into training, held-out testing and evaluation sets.

scenes.name: Element judges
scenes.text: An offence is broken into ingredients; a 4B judge scores each, a 32B judge checks the same ones, and the AND rule needs both.

scenes.name: The harness
scenes.text: Deterministic assembly, the quote check, the Lean structure check and refer-first decide; no model decides.

scenes.name: Nyaya grounding
scenes.text: Pramana, nirnaya withheld and agama, explained in plain words.

scenes.name: The assistant
scenes.text: The optional Claude managed-agent assistant: consent, spending limits, and the core still decides. Offered to signed-in users; optional, with a consent box each run.

scenes.name: Citations
scenes.text: An existence-only check against an index of judgments, and the rule that keeps a name match from passing as proof.

scenes.name: Serving and cost
scenes.text: Local machines plus serverless GPUs, a fallback endpoint, and what idle costs.

scenes.name: Evaluation discipline
scenes.text: Evaluation items are checked against training data, every look at the evaluation set is counted, and results that show no effect are reported.

scenes.name: End card
scenes.text: Name, line and where the technical report lives.
